summary.text: Jay Markell is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 18 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Markell is an attorney, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Jay Markell earned a law degree from the Massachusetts School of Law, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
He assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024.
